def find_largest_palindromic_cube(N: int) -> int:
    index = 1
    l = []
    while True:
        three = index * index * index
        if three > N:
            break
        l.append(three)

        strthree = str(i)
        if strthree == strthree[::-1]:  # Check if the string is a palindrome
